args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The vulnerability affects versions `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; `2.9.4` is the patched 2.x release.

## Testing

CI passed on the branch (`ci-0001`).

2. **Created branch**: `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.

3. **Upgraded**: Committed the change to `requirements.txt` bumping `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`.

4. **Ran CI**: Triggered CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it **passed**.

5. **Opened PR**: Created [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337", with **alex** requested as reviewer.

The PR is open and awaiting review from alex; I did not merge it since merging into main requires code-owner approval.
